### Known gaps

- DeleteCryptoKey, DeleteCryptoKeyVersion, ImportTrustedKeyWrappedCryptoKeyVersion, ExportTrustedKeyWrappedCryptoKeyVersion, Decapsulate, GetRetiredResource and ListRetiredResources are UNIMPLEMENTED.
- EkmService, Autokey, AutokeyAdmin and HsmManagement services are not served; EKM connections and crypto_key_backend are rejected.
- list filter and order_by are rejected as UNIMPLEMENTED on every List RPC.
- Algorithms needing SHA-1 (RSA_DECRYPT_OAEP_*_SHA1, HMAC_SHA1, RSA_OAEP_*_SHA1_AES_256 import), RSA_SIGN_RAW_PKCS1, EC_SIGN_SECP256K1_SHA256, post-quantum and KEM algorithms, AES_256_KWP and EXTERNAL_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION are rejected as unsupported.
- Attestation, key_access_justifications_policy and the version view parameter are not populated.
